discovery_method: telecom-network-ops sweep (WebSearch+WebFetch): DNS/CDN, network monitoring (SNMP/Zabbix/LibreNMS/ThousandEyes), telecom carrier APIs (number provisioning/porting/lookup/CNAM/E911/CDR), VoIP/SIP (Asterisk/FreeSWITCH ARI/AMI), 5G/network-slicing (CAMARA/Open Gateway), IPAM/DCIM (NetBox), BGP/routing (ExaBGP/BIRD/FRR), SD-WAN & cloud network (Meraki/Catalyst Center), network config (NETCONF/RESTCONF/Cisco IOS XE, NAPALM/Netmiko/Nornir)
governance: CANDIDATES ONLY — discovery is not trust. No row here is an active capability; each must pass the seeder's gap/lift screen, then human/eval gates, before any promotion. serves_truth=false for everything downstream. Source URLs are as reported and were spot-verified via WebFetch where noted; license/verify_note flags carried verbatim. CONFIG-WRITE / PROVISIONING / ROUTE-ANNOUNCE / NUMBER-PORT operations are flagged in verify_note and MUST route through boundary approval + review gates before any tenant-facing or live-network use — these mutate real telecom/network state and are NOT eligible for unattended promotion. Carrier number provisioning/porting and E911 carry regulatory (FCC/Ofcom/telecom-regulator) obligations; treat as high-risk review.
